name: 3rd party - CRM embed
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3rd party - CRM embed.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Merchant-owned provider code runs as supplied. The provider must supply accessible iframe titles, its form/calendar configuration, and any editor reload support. Add an actual configured embed; this wrapper does not submit data or confirm bookings.

settings.label: Enable section
settings.how: Turn on “Enable section” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Enter the kicker. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: Book your call or request a quote
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Subheading / description
settings.default: Use the form below to request a quote, schedule a call, or take the next step with our team.
settings.how: Write the subheading / description. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Show bullet list
settings.how: Turn on “Show bullet list” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Embed type
settings.info: Describes this embed for theme integrations. Rendering and behavior are determined by the provider code.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for embed type. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Embed code (form, funnel, or calendar)
settings.info: Paste the full provider HTML/iframe/script snippet. Minimum iframe heights below frame the widget; its script owns resizing and behavior. Test multiple instances and Theme Editor reload with your provider.
settings.how: Write the embed code (form, funnel, or calendar). Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Show trust badges / logos
settings.how: Turn on “Show trust badges / logos” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
